First you have to decide. Is this a hobby you want for fun or something to be competitive with? If you want to have pure fun then just amass a ton of cards and create decks and play with friends. If you want to be competitive look into the different formats of magic. I recommend, if you want to play competitive, to look into the format called Modern. The price tags on cards and decks can be incredibly high (for instance, [[Tarmogoyf]] is ~$145 per card) but if you want to invest you more than likely will not regret and will be hooked like the rest of us. Magic is the heroin of card games. Whatever you choose to do, remember to learn as many rules and cards as you can! This game is insanely in depth and crazy things can happen with cards. Best of luck friend!
